test_title: PYST 29: Selection Post (Matric Level) - General Intelligence (Held On 2 Feb 2022 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question:
Six friends Neha, Priya, Sita, Saroj, Mayank and Vipin are sitting around a circular table, facing towards the center of the table, but not necessarily in the same order. Only Sita is sitting between Vipin and Mayank. Priya is sitting second to the left of Mayank. Saroj is sitting to the immediate right of Vipin.

Who is sitting second to the left of Sita?
solution: Six friends **Neha, Priya, Sita, Saroj, Mayank and Vipin** are sitting around a circular table, facing towards the center of the table, but not necessarily in the same order. 1. Priya is sitting second to the left of Mayank. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ecf3ab8ffcf3cf45432f8500845830f400f6f560ecb2cb764507393ab6c7c689.png] 2. Only Sita is sitting between Vipin and Mayank.
